proposed_widenings.name: grant_condition_immunity
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell grants immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions for the duration. No v4 atom covers this; grant_resistance is damage-type only; apply_condition and remove_condition do not express immunity.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature has Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions until the spell ends.

proposed_widenings.name: suppress_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell suppresses (not removes) already-active Charmed and Frightened conditions for the duration — they return when the spell ends. The v4 suppress atom is a procedure atom, not an Effect atom; the surface has no way to express 'suppress condition X on this target for the spell's duration'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the creature was already Charmed or Frightened, those conditions are suppressed for the duration.

proposed_widenings.name: Condition: charmed | frightened
proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition closed enum currently contains only 'prone'. Encoding condition immunity and suppression for this spell requires charmed and frightened to be present in the type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature has Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions until the spell ends.

proposed_widenings.name: creature_type_filter on area Attachment
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell explicitly targets only Humanoids within the sphere. The area Attachment has no filter predicate for creature type, so the scope would incorrectly include all creatures.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range...

proposed_widenings.name: per_target_caster_choice on save_gate
proposed_widenings.justification: On a failed save the caster chooses, per creature, which of two distinct effects applies. The existing save_gate has a single onFail branch; no surface shape exists for caster-branches-per-target within the same save resolution.
proposed_widenings.evidence: must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects (choose for each creature)

notes: Two distinct v4 atoms are missing (grant_condition_immunity, suppress_condition), forcing atom_widening. Additionally, the secondary effect — making a creature Indifferent toward chosen Hostile creatures, with the indifference reversing on damage — is NPC-attitude territory and best classified as dm_agenda. Even if the attitude effect is set aside, the immunity+suppression effect cannot be honestly encoded. The per-target caster choice and Humanoids-only filter are surface gaps that would also need addressing for a clean trace.
